content: The Lady Dufferin Hospital, located in Karachi, Sindh, is recognized as the largest women’s hospital in Pakistan. The hospital was completed in the year 1898 and was named in honor of Lady Dufferin, a British peeress. In 1990, Benazir Bhutto, the former Prime Minister of Pakistan, gave birth to a daughter at this hospital. Seth Edulji Dinshaw generously donated a sum of Rs. 50,000 for the establishment of the hospital. The foundation laying ceremony of the hospital was conducted on the 12th of November, 1894, by Lady Elgin. Initially, a specific ward within the hospital was designated exclusively for the Parsi community. Later, in January 1917, the Virbaijee Maternity Wing was inaugurated to expand the hospital's services.
